results.title: Sexton, Owens lead Quitman past Yellville-Summit, 48-12
results.description: Quitman quarterback Jack Sexton threw four touchdown passes, and Blake Parrish set a school record with five sacks as the Bulldogs defeated Yellville-Summit 48-12 on Friday night.

results.title: Ruthless Roos leap towards relevance with Blakey blockbuster
results.description: Nick Blakey is not a gun midfielder or a Coleman Medal-winning spearhead, but he is a legitimate All-Australian star with two grand final appearances on his resume.
